questions.q: What false correlation does Harford illustrate with storks?
questions.why: He uses storks to show spurious statistical links.

questions.q: How do experts typically react to contradictory evidence?
questions.why: Harford notes experts avoid conflicting evidence to protect arguments.

questions.q: What caused UK infant mortality variation in the 2010s?
questions.why: Regional definition differences altered mortality stats.

questions.q: What classic experiment shows conformity pressure?
questions.why: Asch demonstrated conformity with line‑choice task.

questions.q: What should you examine when a statistic triggers strong emotions?
questions.why: Harford advises checking what the statistic truly measures.
